messages:
Rhea Gomez: Vendor Asterion Billing reached out asking whether to upload a W-8 or W-9. They also flagged a gross-up clause in their SOW. AP needs tax/legal guidance before we release invoice 10577.

Asterion Billing: Hi Redwood, Asterion Labs here. We are registered in the US as an LLC but 100% owned by a Swiss parent. Please confirm whether we should submit a W-9 or W-8BEN-E. Our SOW (section 4.2) says Redwood will gross-up payments. Link to portal: https://billing.asterion.io/inv/10577

Rhea Gomez: Tagging @Tom Hsu (Tax) and @Danielle (Legal). AP can't clear the invoice without the correct tax form on file.

Tom Hsu (Tax): Short checklist: 1) Are they a U.S. tax resident (EIN + taxed in US)? If yes -> W-9. 2) If they claim foreign status -> W-8BEN-E + foreign tax residency docs. Ownership by a Swiss parent doesn't automatically mean they're foreign for IRS purposes.

Leo (Vendor Ops): Invoice shows "Asterion Labs LLC" with a CA address but no TIN on the PDF. Placed hold for now.

invoice-bot: Invoice 10577 status: ON_HOLD  reason: missing tax form (W-9/W-8).

Danielle (Legal): On gross-up: our default negotiation stance is we do not accept unilateral gross-up obligations. If the SOW was signed with that clause intact we need to see execution evidence (who signed/when). If it's an external vendor template we should have redlined it earlier. Will review SOW page they attached.

Asterion Billing: We can upload either but procurement said W-9 is normal. The Swiss parent asked for treaty clarity in case W-8 is needed. Also the SOW was countersigned last quarter, attached a PDF in the vendor portal.

Tom Hsu (Tax): Action for AP: ask vendor to upload a signed W-9 with EIN. If they insist on W-8 to claim treaty benefits, they must provide W-8BEN-E with country-of-residence docs and FATCA GIIN if applicable. From tax perspective, if W-9 + EIN present -> treat as US payee, no withholding. If W-8 accepted -> apply withholding per IRS schedule unless treaty reduces it.

Rhea Gomez: I'll request the W-9 and EIN and ask them to attach the exact SOW page referencing gross-up so Legal can confirm execution. @Danielle please note AP will hold payment pending your guidance.

Danielle (Legal): Received the SOW PDF. Clause language: "Client shall gross-up all payments to ensure Supplier receives full amount free of withholding." If countersigned by Redwood, we need to check which commercial owner approved it. If not approved, we'll seek amendment. For now do NOT release payment on that basis alone.

Leo (Vendor Ops): Hold remains. Added AP note: "Awaiting W-9/EIN or validated W-8 + Legal confirmation on gross-up."

Asterion Billing: Uploaded signed W-9 and EIN 98-7654321 to the portal per request. Also attached the SOW execution page. Please confirm receipt.

Tom Hsu (Tax): I validated EIN via TIN check. W-9 looks valid. Tax classification: U.S. payee. Recommendation: no withholding and gross-up clause is commercially driven, not a tax requirement. Finance should not apply gross-up unless Legal/Commercial confirm contractual obligation.

Danielle (Legal): I checked signatures; SOW was countersigned but I do not see evidence of commercial approval for gross-up. I'll escalate to Commercial to determine whether to honor or seek amendment.

Rhea Gomez: Thanks all. AP will queue payment for release pending Commercial decision. Tom, please mark vendor as US payee in vendor master. invoice-bot: please keep invoice ON_HOLD until Commercial confirms.

invoice-bot: Invoice 10577 remains ON_HOLD. Last update: W-9 validated, pending Commercial decision on SOW gross-up clause.
